name: Sanity
description: Sanity is a headless CMS and "content operating system" for structured content, letting teams model, manage, and automate content across web, mobile, and agentic platforms via APIs.
best_for: Sanity positions itself for development teams, content operations professionals, and enterprises managing complex, structured content workflows across multiple brands and touchpoints.
features: Real-time webhooks and Content Releases (staged publishing)
